$comment: World reactions. Each rule turns on when its condition holds and off when it stops holding. Conditions: rep.<faction> / terror.<district> with lt|gt. Effects are interpreted by sim/consequences.ts.

rules.label: La garde te recherche : elle t'arrêtera à vue.
Chasse à l'homme : toute la garde est à tes trousses.
Les villageois pavoisent le marché en ton honneur.
Les villageois s'écartent sur ton passage.
La guilde des voleurs te considère comme l'un des siens.
L'Ordre des mages te déclare hérétique.

framing.$comment: Someone blamed for a crime (false face, confused rumor) is arrested by the guard once enough people believe it.

ambient.$comment: Things inhabitants do on their own, so the world log has more than the player's deeds (Echo of the Past, investigations).
